full_name: Nasser Rabbat | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Nasser Rabbat is the Aga Khan Professor of the History of Islamic Architecture and the director of the Aga Khan Program for Islamic Architecture at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
